nodes.label: High Scoring Summary Patterns
nodes.rationale: Evidence-driven patterns that improve summary quality: role clarity first, specialization before soft skills, measurable accomplishments, platform specificity, concise length (40-80 words), and strong role alignment each provide incremental scoring bonuses (10-20 points).

nodes.label: Low Scoring Summary Patterns
nodes.rationale: Anti-patterns that diminish summary quality: adjective openers (-20), personality focus (-10), generic strengths (-10), unsupported seniority claims (-20), buzzword stacking (-15), and keyword stuffing (-20) represent penalties. Hard failures include first-person language, unsupported claims, and generic professional summaries.

nodes.label: Summary Scoring Weights
nodes.rationale: Multi-factor scoring model with normalized weights: relevance_to_jd (30%), specificity_and_evidence (25%), role_alignment (20%), credibility (15%), readability (10%). Total max_score is 100.

nodes.label: Forbidden Summary Opener Buzzwords
nodes.rationale: Nine explicitly forbidden opening phrases identified as low-credibility markers: results-driven, dynamic professional, accomplished professional, highly motivated, dedicated professional, seasoned professional, proven track record, strategic thinker, visionary leader. Must remain a subset of style_rules.yaml forbidden_phrases per consistency test.

nodes.label: Top Third Scoring Weights
nodes.rationale: First-impression quality measured across five dimensions: role_clarity (30%), specialization_visibility (20%), strongest_evidence_visibility (20%), recruiter_comprehension_speed (15%), differentiation (15%). Target comprehension speed is 8 seconds.

nodes.label: Hidden Gem Promotion Rules
nodes.rationale: Rules for surfacing buried accomplishments to top third: promote if revenue_impact, process_ownership, implementation_leadership, platform_expertise, or measurable_business_outcome is present.

nodes.label: Stylometric Voice Quality Thresholds
nodes.rationale: Quantified thresholds for detecting authentic human voice vs. AI pacing: sentence_std_dev_min 4.5 (flags monotonous AI pacing if below), sentence_span_min 12 words, sentence_length_max 55 words, sentence_length_min 3 words, type_token_ratio_min 0.46, max_consecutive_same_opener 2.

nodes.label: Resume CV Template (HTML)
nodes.rationale: Responsive HTML template for rendering tailored resumes to PDF via Chromium. Uses DM Serif Display (serif header) and DM Sans static instances (body text). Disables ligatures to prevent ATS extraction failures where pypdf interprets fi/fl ligatures as special Unicode chars. Features text-wrap: pretty for widow reduction.

nodes.label: Cover Letter Template (HTML)
nodes.rationale: HTML template for rendering tailored cover letters to PDF via Chromium. Uses same font stack as CV template (DM Serif Display + DM Sans static instances, ligatures disabled). Template variables include LANG, DOCUMENT_TITLE, PAGE_WIDTH.

nodes.label: Hiring Algorithms & Scoring Research (August 2026)
nodes.author: Morgan Escott
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive research addressing 20 open questions about hiring platforms (HiringOdds, RippleMatch, CoBlack, Greenhouse, Workday, Lever), ghost job detection (97.64% accuracy achievable), ATS prediction (87% accuracy demonstrated by MokaHR), model drift handling, bias monitoring standards (NYC LL144, EU AI Act, ForHumanity, ISAE 3000), and alternative metrics ROI (10-30% time savings, 10-50% interview rate improvement).

nodes.label: Widget Engineer Test JD Fixture
nodes.rationale: Minimal test fixture for JD parsing and resume tailoring: single-line job description 'We are hiring a Widget Engineer.' Used for smoke tests and build validation.
